paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for four different models. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a linear scale with a range from 1e7 to 9e8. Tick labels are displayed for each power of 10 magnitude between 1e7 and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale with a range from 94 to 100.  Four lines are present: a solid purple line with triangular markers representing "Vanilla", an orange dashed line with circular markers representing "SepLLM (n=64)", a solid blue line with "x" markers representing "SepLLM (n=128)", a dashed green line with triangular markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)", and a solid red line with triangular markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)". The Vanilla line begins at a Loss Ratio of approximately 96.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 99.3% at 9e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to approximately 99.2% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 94.4% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to a peak of approximately 99.4% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then gradually decreases to approximately 98.7% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line initiates at approximately 97.1% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to approximately 99.3% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line begins at approximately 96.9% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99.4% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to approximately 99.2% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at approximately 95% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99.4% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases again to approximately 98.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
